review_scale.0: Not clinically related for the specific research question
review_scale.2: Strongly related with supporting registered information

review_instructions: Review without opening algorithm_key.json; reviewers should not see algorithm sources or community labels.
Use registered title and planned measures as prompts; independently verify source records for substantive judgments.
Do not interpret registered planned outcomes as observed clinical effectiveness or trial results.
Mark uncertain cases U rather than inferring irrelevance; record an evidence-based rationale.
Prefer two independent reviewers with adjudication for disagreements; predefine relevance threshold before unblinding.
This is a fixed exploratory transductive trial-neighbor evaluation; no held-out clinical generalization claim.
